errors.description: The conditions for both optional attachments refer to an edge from the new bag to Bₓ₃ and add an edge to x₂. As written, e₄ never adds the x₄ attachment needed for the subsequent subdivision of C₁₄₃ into faces f₁₄ and f₄₃. This leaves the claimed construction and face analysis unsupported in this case.
errors.evidence: “if there is an edge e₂ = (vₖ₊₁, v₂), where v₂ ∈ Bₓ₃, we also connect xₖ₊₁ to x₂. Similarly, if there is an edge e₄ = (vₖ₊₁, v₂), where … v₂ ∈ Bₓ₃, we also connect xₖ₊₁ to x₂.” The following text uses e₄ to split C₁₄₃ and create f₁₄ and f₄₃.

errors.description: The path P is defined with d vertices, but the proof uses it for d+1 layers indexed 0 through d, including p₀, which is undefined. Thus the stated embedding construction does not assign product coordinates to every layer.
errors.evidence: “let P = (p₁, p₂, …, p_d)” followed by “for a fixed layer i ∈ {0, …, d}” and references to pᵢ.

errors.description: In the case x ≠ x′ and y ≠ y′, the two candidate edges in H corresponding to the nesting pair are (x,y) and (x′,y′). The proof instead invokes (x,y) and (y,y′); since it has already established y ≠ x′, this is not the second candidate edge. The cited non-nesting property therefore does not establish the claim for this case.
errors.evidence: “If x ≠ x′ and y ≠ y′, we obtain that the order … corresponds to … x, x′, y, y′. As edges (x, y), (y, y′) do not nest in H_h…”
